item.title: RimWorld Gene Designer — Xenotype Metabolic Budget (1.6 & Odyssey)
item.description: Use the RimWorld gene designer to plan a xenotype and check its metabolic budget — pick combat, immunity, psycast and personality genes — built for the current 1.6 / Odyssey version with the Biotech expansion. Gene Designer — Metabolic Budget Gene Designer — Metabolic Budget Check the genes you want; see the metabolic cost total and whether the pawn stays balanced.
